source.modification: Each upstream fill="#212121" is changed to fill="currentColor". Geometry, viewBox, dimensions, element order and size-specific optical masters are otherwise unchanged.

theme_contract.default: currentColor inherits the consuming foreground token
theme_contract.selected_navigation: filled navigation variants may use color.accent.brass with a visible text label and another current-state cue
theme_contract.state_color: state icons may use approved V2 state tokens on a contrast-compatible surface; shape and visible text remain required
theme_contract.paper_surface: use color.text.ink unless a state token independently meets 3:1 against the actual adjacent paper treatment
theme_contract.unavailable: use a perceivable foreground token and the unavailable shape plus visible text; never represent unavailable only with opacity

shared_accessibility: Navigation and state icons require visible text. Future icon-only conventional action controls require an accessible name at the UI layer. Static assets do not claim native assistive-technology behavior.

icons.variant_use: regular by default; filled only for the current destination
icons.accessibility: Pair with the visible label Operations.
prohibited_uses: Do not interpret the board cells as campaign facts or live system health.

icons.variant_use: regular by default; filled only for the current destination
icons.accessibility: Pair with the visible label Pilot Dossier.
prohibited_uses: The generic person silhouette must not imply pilot identity, rank, service, nationality or status.

icons.variant_use: regular by default; filled only for the current destination
icons.accessibility: Pair with the visible label Missions.
prohibited_uses: The generic airplane is navigation only and must not imply aircraft model, mission type, service or outcome.

icons.variant_use: regular by default; filled only for the current destination
icons.accessibility: Pair with the visible label Squadron.
prohibited_uses: The generic group must not imply actual roster membership, squadron identity or transfer status.

icons.variant_use: regular by default; filled only for the current destination
icons.accessibility: Pair with the visible label War Diary.
prohibited_uses: Do not use the book silhouette to imply that a narrative or authoritative entry exists.

icons.variant_use: regular by default; filled only for the current destination
icons.accessibility: Pair with the visible label Reports.
prohibited_uses: Do not use the document marks to imply report availability, completeness or authoritative counts.

icons.variant_use: regular by default; filled only for the current destination
icons.accessibility: Pair with the visible label Data & System Status.
prohibited_uses: This read-only destination icon must not imply editable settings, repair, live health or launcher control.

icons.accessibility: Pair with visible informational text; the icon alone is not an announcement.
prohibited_uses: Do not substitute for warning, error, complete or unavailable.

icons.accessibility: Pair with visible Complete or Success wording that matches the supplied presentation state.
prohibited_uses: Do not infer completeness, source authority or success from the icon.

icons.display_purpose: Partial record or warning requiring attention
icons.accessibility: Pair with visible Partial record or specific warning text; shape distinguishes it from stale.
prohibited_uses: Do not substitute for stale, unavailable or failed-query error.

icons.accessibility: Pair with visible Stale wording and the safe observation time when supplied.
prohibited_uses: Do not use for pending loading, generic warning or unknown freshness.

icons.accessibility: Pair with a visible sanitized error message and permitted recovery action.
prohibited_uses: Do not use for missing, unsupported, unreadable, partial or unavailable content states.

icons.display_purpose: Content or source is explicitly unavailable
icons.accessibility: Pair with visible Not available wording and a safe reason when supplied; retain a 3:1 boundary.
prohibited_uses: Never encode unavailable only through opacity or use it as a generic disabled-control icon.

icons.variant_use: retry or refresh according to the visible action label
icons.accessibility: Use visible Retry view or Refresh snapshot text; an icon-only future control requires an accessible name.
prohibited_uses: Must not imply direct storage access, writes, ingestion, repair or synchronization.

icons.display_purpose: Return to the parent or originating read-only view
icons.accessibility: Pair with a visible destination label when practical; an icon-only future control requires an accessible name.
prohibited_uses: Do not use for previous chronological record unless the control actually performs back navigation.

icons.accessibility: The surrounding visible control label names the details; an icon-only future control requires an accessible name and state where expandable.
prohibited_uses: Do not use as a generic decoration or as evidence that details exist.
